claim: Holding the cheapest 20% of eligible listed closed-end funds by raw discount to NAV, equal weight, traded at the next close and rebalanced every 21 sessions in 21 tranches at CEF costs, beats the equal-weight eligible CEF universe after the search that found it. Candidate selection was post-hoc: the highest-active-Sharpe grid point whose active return survives doubled costs (disclosed in H404701).
notes: Forward window 365 days: at a true active Sharpe of ~1 the 0.90 PSR floor passes ~40% of the time; a longer window would be fairer but slower. Survivorship (current listings only) is the principal untested threat.
universe: CEFConnect-listed closed-end funds in NAV panel fd7099e252ccd34aec6829b5617dface66318c8a3756808d95c4a21d6b19b35f
